description: Navigate and fight sentries through a shared visual turn; sentries advance only after deliberate input.
name: Clockbeat Catacomb V2 · Difficulty 4 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Defeat every sentry and enter the stair alive. Wind the clock, then use arrows or WASD (Space waits) once per turn. The displayed gold action window stays available until you act; sentries act once after each deliberate input. Use only screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs.
